en: Um, (*APELLIDO_HEROE*)...? {PAUSE}[2000]{SAUT}Never mind... it's nothing.{ATTENTE}
The black market, eh...? {PAUSE}[3000]It's a good fit{SAUT}for this lawless town.{ATTENTE}
It's good to see the doctor hasn't{SAUT}changed a bit.{ATTENTE}
I'm relieved that the doctor's just the{SAUT}way he always is.{ATTENTE}
So the doc's the same as ever...{ATTENTE}
I was worried what we'd do if he turned{SAUT}out to be some skinhead with an eyepatch!{ATTENTE}
He's... {PAUSE}[2000]He's not gonna give us shots,{SAUT}is he...?{ATTENTE}
Huh. I was expecting the doctor to be...{SAUT}stranger, I guess.{ATTENTE}
The reason I'm so happy is all because{SAUT}of the Harem Queen.{ATTENTE}
Let's all give thanks to the Queen!{SAUT}Hooray for the Queen!{ATTENTE}
It was never the Queen who made me happy!{ATTENTE}
But now who am I supposed to thank?{ATTENTE}
What, did you catch a cold? Then go{SAUT}sleep it off!{ATTENTE}
My fee is 1,500 yen. Well?{ATTENTE}
This Sennen Mannen-Do is very weird...{ATTENTE}
This market seems devoid of normal shops.{ATTENTE}
I guess the Sennen Mannen-Do in this town{SAUT}doesn't sell sweets.{ATTENTE}
How exotic! What a wonderful store!{ATTENTE}
This jar's pretty neat. Hey (*APODO_HEROE*),{SAUT}could you buy this for me as a gift?{ATTENTE}
Did you talk to the clerks here?{SAUT}Their makeup is like, really weird!{ATTENTE}
...Is this place haunted?{ATTENTE}
If I was a beautiful youth who looked like{SAUT}a stray dog, the Queen would've liked me!{ATTENTE}
Then I could've kicked back at the palace{SAUT}instead of living in this dump.{ATTENTE}
The men in the harem all had to swear{SAUT}their loyalty to the Queen, right?{ATTENTE}
That's so lame...{ATTENTE}
I'm gonna live the way I want, without{SAUT}submitting to anyone.{ATTENTE}
This store's owned by the uncle of a{SAUT}friend of mine named Tadashi.{ATTENTE}
Tadashi doesn't get along with Tamaki,{SAUT}this transfer student.{ATTENTE}
He won't speak even one word to her.{ATTENTE}
...If you want to recover HP then use...{ATTENTE}
Fine! I surrender! Here, (*APELLIDO_HEROE*),{SAUT}you sing along too!{ATTENTE}
Tadashi's uncle, huh? This place doesn't{SAUT}seem that different from our version.{ATTENTE}
I don't mean to be rude, but I do wonder{SAUT}how effective the medicine here is...{ATTENTE}
Hey... That guy's hair... That's not{SAUT}a wig, is it?{ATTENTE}
Baby stuff is all so cute. I just like{SAUT}looking at it.{ATTENTE}
What a maniac...{ATTENTE}
Welcome to Satomi Tadashi! Feel free to{SAUT}call me "the Satster"!{ATTENTE}
Now, on to business!{ATTENTE}
I'm a little down in the dumps today.{ATTENTE}
At times like these, all I can do is go{SAUT}to the bar and discuss the Queen's art.{ATTENTE}
The Queen's finally gone! This calls for{SAUT}a drink or five!{ATTENTE}
You can't go in there. Nope, not even{SAUT}a peek!{ATTENTE}
Um... (*APELLIDO_HEROE*)... To tell the truth,{SAUT}I...{ATTENTE}
Hmm... It's necessary to enjoy oneself{SAUT}sometimes, I suppose.{ATTENTE}
All right! Get ready to be dazzled by{SAUT}my poker skills!{ATTENTE}
I detest this sort of place! The air's{SAUT}so foul!{ATTENTE}
Heheh! It's all about the casinos!{ATTENTE}
By the way, (*APODO_HEROE*)... What do you{SAUT}think of those guys at the counter...?{ATTENTE}
Hey, (*APELLIDO_HEROE*)! Stock up on coins and{SAUT}buy me some earrings!{ATTENTE}
Whaaat!? All they have is stuff like{SAUT}Para Stones? What a letdown!{ATTENTE}
Hmph... Ridiculous.{ATTENTE}
You're not wearing any moles. Did you{SAUT}just get here?{ATTENTE}
The fashion right now is to follow the{SAUT}Queen's example with lots of moles.{ATTENTE}
Oops, I forgot to take off my moles.{SAUT}Man, those things were ugly!{ATTENTE}
Sometimes I see a little girl in black{SAUT}at this market.{ATTENTE}
I hate to think of a helpless little{SAUT}girl trapped here too...{ATTENTE}
Rumor has it that the girl in black{SAUT}grants any wish you want.{ATTENTE}
